# Adobe (ADBE) and Alibaba (BABA) Deep Dive Analysis

Report 050 | Published 2021-03-14 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2021-3-14/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/050.json)

Inflation thresholds and two growth selections.

The spring inflation threshold and Bitcoin new-high call were successful. Broad student forgiveness failed to be implemented, and the explicit multi-year Adobe and Alibaba investment cases performed poorly. Their disclosed valuation and political risks deserve weight in the outcome.

**Coverage:** All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

## Claims

### 050-C01

**Jobs recover gradually**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Right |
| Type | forecast |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | US payrolls |
| Source blocks | 21, 22 |
| Thesis family | jobs-gradual-recovery |

Payrolls eventually regained their pre-pandemic level in July 2022, consistent with a gradual recovery rather than an immediate reopening restoration. This supports timing direction, not an exact monthly path.

**Direction:** Resolved as stated.

**Timing:** No fixed endpoint supplied.

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [July 2022 Employment Situation release](https://www.bls.gov/news.release/archives/empsit_08052022.htm) | Bureau of Labor Statistics | 2022-08-05 | Verified in the audit

The release reported payroll employment and unemployment rate had returned to February 2020 levels in July 2022. This is a publication-vintage recovery date, not a claim about subsequently revised payroll history.

The payoff arithmetic is broadly correct if the quoted premium was executable. Crossing the strike does not force early assignment; the holder chooses exercise. Annualizing one three-month premium does not promise repeatable annual returns, and downside below breakeven remains stock-like.

**Direction:** See reason; no return inferred.

**Outcome evidence:**

- [Options assignment FAQ](https://www.optionseducation.org/referencelibrary/faq/options-assignment) | Options Industry Council / OCC | Verified in the audit

American-style exercise is the holder's decision before expiration. At expiration, exercise-by-exception thresholds and contrary instructions apply; going in the money does not itself compel early assignment.
